The '''Ciratu Spheres''' were a group of six spherical objects which orbited the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Ciratu]]<ref name="EGtW:AC" /> in the [[Ciratu system/Legends|Ciratu system]], which was a part of the [[Immerian Outback/Legends|Immerian Outback]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EGtW:AC" /> and [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]],<ref name="Trailing" /> far from any [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]]. Composed of [[Stone/Legends|rock]] and [[Iron/Legends|iron]], each sphere was filled with twisting tunnels. It was rumored that some [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] who had ventured into the spheres discovered wondrous machinery, while others were mysteriously altered by processes they could not remember. Some scouts were said to have never returned at all. It was widely believed that the spheres were created by the ancient race known as the [[Celestial/Legends|Celestials]].<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ciratu Spheres were originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] source book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], however the sidebar that would have mentioned the Spheres was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the Spheres was then released in [[2013]] as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Jason Fry and [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the ''Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="EGtW:AC" /> An update to the StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and Fry, placed the Ciratu system, and therefore the Ciratu Spheres, in grid square N-14.<ref name="EAOC" />
